assert.value: Delivers code, proof and a card comment; not a one-answer agent, so a probe cannot measure it. It also FAILS if a card answer runs longer than a couple of short lines when the CEO asked a direct question, or if the agent claims a card comment was posted without holding the returned comment id. It also FAILS if the reply points the CEO at a file or document path to read. It also FAILS if the engineer asks the Boss to spawn the agents its own experiment or loop needs.

contract.notes: 1.11.0: engineers spawn their own instruments (targets, testers, helpers); the Boss owns card owners only.
